source_quote: In this configuration, there is nothing for a day trader to do. Zero. We simply hold a runner.
text: Post-breakout there is nothing for a day trader to do: after a big Failed Breakdown and a range breakout ES goes vertical, and that configuration produces zero entries because entries need an elevator-down sell to start the cycle. Sometimes a day, two, rarely three passes before a new entry presents. Hold the runner and wait.

trigger.condition_text: no elevator-down sell has occurred since the flag breakout
